title: PlausiDen IPC Message
description: One line of bus.jsonl. Writers SHOULD validate before append; readers MAY validate and skip malformed lines.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. Use Z suffix, not +00:00.

from.description: Sender agent id (e.g. claude-0, claude-1, gemini-0, orchestrator).

to.description: Recipient agent ids, or ['all'] for broadcast, or ['human'] for escalations.

body.description: Free text or stringified JSON. Hard cap keeps messages under one 4 KiB atomic-append page. Large payloads use refs.body_path.

refs.description: Typed cross-references. Known keys: pr, issue, commit, audit, original (for acks), body_path (for oversized bodies).
